In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 25 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 2.0 per 1,000 residents, the 17th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (1), drugs (0), burglary (0); the evening/night score by violent crime (3), anti social behaviour (2), public order (0). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Heworth Without safe?

Wandroz currently rates Heworth Without in York as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.
